business_summary.text: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited is a diamond jewellery retail player with 36 stores across Maharashtra, transitioning to a COCO-led expansion model.

call_points.text: Company plans to open 6 to 7 EBO stores in FY27 out of the remaining 14 planned stores.

auditor_history.name: MSKA & Associates LLP
auditor_history.note: Statutory auditors have issued an audit report with an unmodified opinion on the audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Gems, Jewellery And Watches

operating_notes.text: Akshaya Tritiya revenue of ₹12.73 Cr in FY27, up 267% YoY from ₹3.46 Cr in FY26
As on May 11, 2026, the Company has 34 SIS stores with P. N. Gadgil & Sons Limited and 2 exclusive brand stores.
Raised ₹380 Cr through IPO for working capital and store expansion.
Average order value for FY26 stood at ₹1,20,000.
HDFC Bank released ₹12,352 held due to an MHA complaint into the ICICI Bank escrow account on April 9, 2026.
Total store count stands at 39 stores as of October 2026.

holders.name: Tata Mutual Fund - Tata Value Fund

timeline.summary: PNGS Reva reported ₹12.73 Cr revenue on Akshaya Tritiya 2026, a 267% YoY increase, with new EBOs contributing ₹0.69 Cr.
Govind Vishwanath Gadgil, Promoter, declared no encumbrances on PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹138.13 Cr, net profit ₹21.41 Cr.
PNGS Reva reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹138.13 Cr, up 139% YoY, and PAT of ₹21.41 Cr, up 350% YoY.
Kirti Vaidya, ICSI M. No. A31430, hosted an analysts/institutional investor meet and earnings call on May 11, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST, with recording available via the company’s website.
PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery reported ₹39.69 Cr utilised out of ₹379.51 Cr IPO proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
PNGS Reva reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹138 Cr and FY26 revenue of ₹439 Cr, outlining expansion plans for 14 new EBO stores.
PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery clarified that a minor IPO fund transfer delay of ₹12,352 due to an MHA complaint was resolved with funds credited on April 9, 2026.
PNGS Reva Diamond reported Dussehra revenue of ₹12.19 Cr, up 62.4% YoY, and a total store count of 39.

watchlist.text: Approval of members in ensuing Annual General Meeting for appointment of Secretarial Auditor
